Description: City of Juanjuí (San Martín, Peru); patients notified to the epidemiological surveillance system of the Mariscal Cáceres Territorial Health Management Unit
Notification between January and June 2025, residence in Juanjuí and household inspected (at least one container examined) within 7 days after notification
252 patients (124 positive and 128 negative); all eligible notified patients were included, without a formal sample size calculation
Probable dengue case notified to the surveillance system; the same definition for positive and negative patients
January to June 2025, a single transmission period; adjustment for month of notification
At least one container with immature stages of Ae. aegypti in the patient’s household (main analysis); Container Index as a continuous variable (secondary analysis)

Indoor inspection by surveillance and vector control staff following the national technical standard, with the same protocol in both groups; median of 2 days (cases) and 1 day (controls) after notification; households inspected more than 7 days later were excluded
Larval indices (containers and households with larvae or pupae); pupal and adult indices were not used

ELISA [PENDING KEPLER: state whether the ELISA detected NS1, IgM or both, the commercial kit, the laboratory that processed it, the days between symptom onset and sampling, and whether RT-PCR confirmation was performed]; the positive or negative classification derives from the optical density of the assay
Not recorded in the data matrix, so the analysis could not be restricted to samples taken in the window of highest test sensitivity
Unconditional logistic regression, without matching; block-clustered robust standard errors and inverse probability of inclusion weighting as sensitivity analyses
Age (continuous), sex, month of notification and sector (fixed effect); occupation in an additional model; water storage practices, crowding and household income were not available
Negative dengue result in the same test; results for other arboviruses, such as chikungunya or Zika, were not available
Crude and adjusted OR of a household with Ae. aegypti between positive and negative patients
